# Access

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Create, reveal, roll or revoke an API key

- **What it is:** Keys for developers, automation tools and AI apps that cannot sign in: create, reveal, roll and revoke them.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial. A key needs a connected number first.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins. A member cannot open API keys.
- **Where:** API keys > Create API key
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/api-keys.md, section "create-a-key". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/api-keys#create-a-key

## See or revoke a connected AI app

- **What it is:** Every AI app connected to the organization, with its access, numbers, who connected it and when it was last used.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency, the 14-day trial and the Free plan. Removing Whatsable from the AI app does not revoke the connection. A connection cannot be edited: revoke it and connect again.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** API keys > Connected AI apps > Revoke
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/manage-access.md, section "see-your-connected-ai-apps". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/manage-access#see-your-connected-ai-apps
